title: The House of Winding Stairs
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The house at the end of Maple Street has a staircase that moves — eleven-year-old Noah has counted it rearranging itself at night. When his family moves in, he learns the stairs are a map: each landing leads to a room from a different year of the house\'s history, and one room leads to the year his grandfather disappeared.
